quotes.text: The first time we flew to Australia by prop (ie propeller driven airplane) it took thirty-two hours, you shaved twice, it was ridiculous.
I wrote it about a girl I met on that trip. Her name was Lillian, and she was very, very inspirational. I was married, but… you know.
I'd fallen in love with her and was afraid that I was never going to see her again, in those days Australia seemed like the end of the world.
